proposedEntry.name: animation-vocabulary
proposedEntry.description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague, feel-based description of a web animation or motion effect ('the bouncy thing when a popover opens', 'the iOS rubber-band scroll') into its precise, quotable term, organized into ten categories (entrances/exits, sequencing, transforms, state transitions, scroll, feedback, easing, springs, looping, polish, performance, and design principles) with a disambiguation method for near-synonymous terms like clip-path vs. mask or pop-in vs. bounce.
triggers: what's the term for this transition
how do I describe this effect to an AI
inputs: a loose, sensation-based description of an animation or motion effect
outputs: the matching glossary term with its definition, plus close alternates and how they differ when ambiguous
